subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: The routing policy shall specify an independent implementation-role and review-role result for every cell in the required routing domain.
rationale: review must not inherit implementation capacity accidentally, and support cannot shrink by declaration
fit_criterion: conformance enumerates the required domain from the runtime contract and derivation policy; every cell has a qualified satisfying mapping or the FR-10 unsupported result; no required harness or profile is omitted
